title: Vision-based GNSS-Free Localization for UAVs in the Wild
summary: Proposes matching drone camera frames to open satellite imagery with learned feature matching to get absolute position without GNSS, evaluated on flights over non-urban areas.
key_takeaways: Satellite tiles + learned matcher is a workable visual GPS baseline
Failure cases cluster over low-texture and changed terrain

title: AnyLoc: Towards Universal Visual Place Recognition
summary: Shows that unsupervised aggregation of foundation-model (DINOv2) features gives place recognition that generalizes across domains including aerial imagery, without VPR-specific training.
key_takeaways: Foundation features + VLAD work training-free
Aerial domain included in the evaluation

title: Exploring the best way for UAV visual localization under Low-altitude Multi-view Observation Condition: a Benchmark
summary: Builds a benchmark for low-altitude, oblique-view UAV absolute visual localization and systematically compares retrieval, matching and refinement choices.
key_takeaways: Low-altitude oblique views are much harder than nadir
Gives evidence for picking retrieval/matcher combos

title: UAV-VisLoc: A Large-scale Dataset for UAV Visual Localization
summary: Introduces a dataset of real UAV flight images paired with satellite maps over varied terrain for evaluating UAV visual localization.
key_takeaways: Real flights with ground truth
Covers terrain types beyond cities

title: Long-range UAV Thermal Geo-localization with Satellite Imagery
summary: Matches night-time UAV thermal imagery to satellite RGB maps using domain adaptation to cope with scarce paired thermal-satellite data; releases code and a nighttime dataset.
key_takeaways: Night visual GPS is possible via thermal-to-RGB matching
Domain adaptation offsets missing paired data

title: STHN: Deep Homography Estimation for UAV Thermal Geo-localization with Satellite Imagery
summary: Refines thermal-to-satellite localization with learned homography estimation for precise alignment.
key_takeaways: Coarse-to-fine: retrieval then homography

title: UASTHN: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Homography Estimation for UAV Satellite-Thermal Geo-localization
summary: Adds uncertainty estimation to satellite-thermal homography so a navigation filter can weight or reject visual fixes.
key_takeaways: Uncertainty makes visual fixes filter-ready

title: University-1652: A Multi-view Multi-source Benchmark for Drone-based Geo-localization
summary: Introduces the drone/satellite/ground benchmark that most drone cross-view geo-localization work evaluates on.
key_takeaways: Defines drone->satellite and satellite->drone retrieval tasks

title: SUES-200: A Multi-height Multi-scene Cross-view Image Benchmark Across Drone and Satellite
summary: Drone-satellite benchmark with imagery at several flight heights across varied scenes.
key_takeaways: Altitude changes strongly affect retrieval accuracy

title: Sample4Geo: Hard Negative Sampling For Cross-View Geo-Localisation
summary: Shows that a simple contrastive setup with careful hard-negative sampling performs strongly on cross-view geo-localization benchmarks.
key_takeaways: Data sampling matters as much as architecture

title: LightGlue: Local Feature Matching at Light Speed
summary: Redesigns SuperGlue-style attention matching to be faster and adaptive, stopping early on easy pairs.
key_takeaways: Adaptive depth trades compute for difficulty
Permissive license, easy to deploy

title: RoMa: Robust Dense Feature Matching
summary: Dense matcher combining foundation-model coarse features with fine refinement, robust to large appearance change.
key_takeaways: Dense warps + certainty help on cross-season, cross-sensor pairs

title: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
summary: Frames matching as a 3D problem on top of DUSt3R, producing dense matches robust to extreme viewpoint change.
key_takeaways: 3D reasoning handles oblique-vs-nadir gaps

title: XFeat: Accelerated Features for Lightweight Image Matching
summary: Lightweight feature extraction and matching architecture aimed at real-time use on constrained hardware.
key_takeaways: Real-time matching without a big GPU

title: Optimal Transport Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
summary: Introduces SALAD, aggregating DINOv2 local features into a global descriptor via optimal transport.
key_takeaways: Strong retrieval descriptor for the coarse localization stage

title: From Coarse to Fine: Robust Hierarchical Localization at Large Scale
summary: Foundational paper for hierarchical localization: global retrieval to find candidate places, then local matching for precise pose.
key_takeaways: Retrieve-then-match is the scalable pattern

title: A Review on Deep Learning for UAV Absolute Visual Localization
summary: Survey of deep-learning approaches to UAV absolute visual localization against reference maps since 2019, in the journal Drones.
key_takeaways: Good map of methods, datasets and open problems
Follows the same authors' 2021 review

title: Signal Enhancement for Magnetic Navigation Challenge Problem
summary: Defines the MagNav challenge from the DAF-MIT AI Accelerator: separate the Earth's magnetic anomaly signal from aircraft interference using real flight data, framed as a scientific machine-learning problem.
key_takeaways: Aircraft magnetic compensation is the core difficulty
Provides real survey-flight data and a baseline

title: MagNav.jl documentation
summary: Documentation and examples for MagNav.jl covering data loading, compensation models, map handling and navigation filters.
key_takeaways: Fastest route to running MagNav examples

title: MagNav - MIT CSAIL open-source technologies
summary: Overview page for MagNav as an open-source technology from the DAF-MIT AI Accelerator.
key_takeaways: Context on program origin and goals

title: Absolute Positioning Using the Earth's Magnetic Anomaly Field
summary: AFIT dissertation establishing airborne magnetic anomaly navigation methods and flight-test evaluation, the basis for later AFRL/MIT MagNav work.
key_takeaways: Map-matching filter design for scalar magnetometers
Flight-test evidence of absolute positioning from anomaly maps

title: Magnetic Sensors in Flight Tests as Alternative PNT to GNSS
summary: Trade-press overview of Air Force magnetic navigation flight testing and the research path from AFIT to operational trials.
key_takeaways: MagNav moved from lab to aircraft tests

title: Quantum-assured magnetic navigation achieves positioning accuracy better than a strategic-grade INS in airborne and ground-based field trials
summary: Reports airborne and ground field trials of magnetic anomaly navigation using quantum magnetometers with map-matching, comparing against strategic-grade inertial navigation.
key_takeaways: Recent field evidence that MagNav is a practical GNSS alternative
Sensor quality and noise rejection drive performance

title: Adaptable Navigation Systems (ANS)
summary: DARPA program page for ANS, which pursued GPS-quality PNT in denied environments through precision inertial sensors (PINS) and the All Source Positioning and Navigation (ASPN) sensor-fusion effort.
key_takeaways: ASPN aimed at plug-and-play fusion of many nav sensors
Framed GNSS denial as a core military problem

title: DARPA Seeks PNT Robustness, Flexibility with All Source Positioning and Navigation Program
summary: Background article on DARPA ASPN: a navigation architecture that accepts arbitrary combinations of sensors (cameras, magnetometers, radios, IMUs) with rapid reconfiguration.
key_takeaways: Shows the plug-and-play sensor-fusion goal that later GNSS-denied architectures inherit

title: Navigation using carrier Doppler shift from a LEO constellation: TRANSIT on steroids
summary: Analyzes positioning from carrier Doppler measurements of a large LEO constellation with a batch filter estimating position, velocity and clock terms, showing accuracy potentially comparable to pseudorange GNSS.
key_takeaways: Doppler-only LEO positioning is geometrically viable
Needs many satellites in view; mega-constellations supply them

title: Exploiting Starlink Signals for Navigation: First Results
summary: Early experimental demonstration of opportunistic positioning by tracking Doppler from Starlink satellites, without cooperation from the operator.
key_takeaways: Starlink can be used as an uncooperative PNT source
Ephemeris error is a dominant limitation

title: Positioning with Starlink LEO Satellites: A Blind Doppler Spectral Approach
summary: Estimates Doppler from Starlink downlinks blindly in the frequency domain without knowing the signal structure, and uses it for positioning from a poor initial estimate.
key_takeaways: Blind spectral Doppler avoids needing proprietary signal details

title: Initialization-Free LEO Doppler Positioning via Semidefinite Relaxation: A Cold-Start Approach
summary: Formulates LEO Doppler positioning as an optimization solvable by semidefinite relaxation so it does not need a good initial position guess.
key_takeaways: Removes the initialization problem in Doppler positioning

title: Complementary PNT and GPS Backup Technologies Demonstration Report
summary: Field demonstration of 11 GPS-backup technologies (including eLoran, terrestrial beacons, LEO and fiber timing) against defined scenarios, delivered to Congress.
key_takeaways: No single technology fully backs up GPS
eLoran fails differently from GNSS, which is its value

title: tetra3 documentation
summary: Usage and API documentation for the tetra3 lost-in-space star plate solver, including database generation and solving images.
key_takeaways: Database generation controls speed vs field-of-view range

title: OpenSky: A Modular and Open-Source Simulator of Sky Polarization Measurements
summary: Open simulator of what a polarimetric camera sees of the sky (intensity, angle and degree of polarization), validated against real captures, for developing polarization compasses.
key_takeaways: Lets you test sky-polarization heading without field data

title: Ukraine's Autonomous Killer Drones Defeat Electronic Warfare
summary: Reporting on how Ukrainian drone developers respond to pervasive jamming of radio links and satellite navigation, including onboard optical navigation that keeps the drone flying after links are lost.
key_takeaways: Jamming makes onboard, map-based navigation a front-line requirement
Optical navigation is spreading to cheap drones

title: UAVs: ISR, Deterrence and War (IISS Strategic Dossier)
summary: IISS dossier on military UAV use, noting that GNSS is often effectively unavailable near the front line in Ukraine and that visual scene-matching navigation is a growing response.
key_takeaways: GNSS denial is the operating norm near the front
Scene-matching navigation has decades of lineage

title: Ukrainian Drones Use Vermeer Optical Navigation System
summary: Ukrainian defense outlet reporting that a US company's optical (visual) navigation system is being integrated into Ukrainian reconnaissance and strike drones.
key_takeaways: Commercial visual-navigation modules are reaching the field
